claims.claim: The bike is just 3 months old
claims.evidence: No date-stamped proof, purchase receipt, or manufacture plate visible; moss staining on ground suggests the bike has been stored outdoors for some time, but this says nothing about the bike's own age.
Only a rear three-quarter view is shown; engine, tank, front end, tires and underside are not visible, so overall condition cannot be confirmed.

risks.risk: Engine may not start or may run poorly
risks.proof: Video of cold start with engine sound and idle

risks.risk: Accident or frame damage hidden on unseen side
risks.proof: Full walk-around photos of both sides, front, and underside

risks.risk: Registration/ownership mismatch (plate holder is an improvised paper plate, not a standard plate)
risks.proof: Photo of actual registration document/particulars and permanent plate matching VIN
risks.if_unproven: priced as unregistered/ownership-unverified, raising fraud caution

risks.proof: Close-up of tire tread and a photo/video of battery terminals or electric start response

risks.risk: Brand/model unknown, affecting base value tier
risks.proof: Clear shot of fuel tank badge, side panel logo, or VIN plate
risks.if_unproven: priced at generic low-tier motorcycle value until brand/model confirmed

proof_requests: Close-up of fuel tank/side badge or VIN plate to confirm brand and model
Full walk-around: front, both sides, underside
Clear photo of registration/ownership document matching the plate shown
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a motorcycle, so it can be priced at worst case for an unidentified-brand, unverified-condition unit; the seller's age and condition claims remain unverifiable remotely, and the improvised paper plate is a documentation red flag worth noting.
